  "output": "# Chat Bots Design Notes

## Data Model
- Bots are modeled on `User` with `role: :bot` (in `User::Role`: `enum :role, %i[ member administrator bot ]`) and `User::Bot` concern.
- `users.bot_token` (unique indexed string) stores the bot's secret authentication token (`SecureRandom.base58(24)`), generated on creation when `role == "bot"`.
- `users.webhook_url` (optional string) stores the bot's HTTP webhook callback URL, normalized from blank strings to `nil` so clearing the field removes the webhook. Validated as an HTTP/HTTPS URL with a host (private/loopback hosts are permitted for self-hosted/local bot services).
- `users.add_to_all_open_rooms` (boolean, default `false`, `null: false`) controls whether a bot automatically joins all open rooms. By default bots do not join open rooms automatically (human users still do).
- `users.creator_id` (foreign key to `users`) tracks who created the bot so `Current.user.can_administer?(bot)` naturally grants access to administrators and the bot's creator.
- Modeling bots as `User` records allows bots to reuse:
  - `Membership` (toggle-based assignment on both `Rooms::Open` and `Rooms::Closed`, optional auto-joining on `Rooms::Open`, `@mention` autocomplete, and unread tracking).
  - `Message#creator` (`belongs_to :creator, class_name: "User"`), displaying the bot's name and avatar in messages and web push notifications.
  - `User::Avatar` (`fresh_user_avatar_path`, uploaded avatars, and SVG initials fallback).
- Deleting a bot calls `User#deactivate` (sets `status: :deactivated`, clears `bot_token`, `webhook_url`, and `add_to_all_open_rooms: false`, removes non-direct room memberships) so historical messages remain intact with the bot's name while immediately revoking API access and webhook delivery.
- Human-only surfaces (`AccountsController`, `Accounts::UsersController`, `SessionsController`, `Sessions::TransfersController`, `Users::BansController`, `Users::SidebarsController`) scope to `User.not_bot` so bots cannot log in, be promoted/banned, or clutter account member lists.

## Open Room Membership Control
- `User.auto_joining_open_rooms` scopes to `not_bot.or(bot.where(add_to_all_open_rooms: true))`.
- `Rooms::Open#grant_access_to_all_users` uses `User.active.auto_joining_open_rooms`, so creating an open room or converting a closed room to open adds all active people and any bots with `add_to_all_open_rooms: true`.
- Turning `add_to_all_open_rooms` on (on creation or update via `after_update_commit`) grants memberships to all existing `Rooms::Open` via `Membership.insert_all(..., returning: %w[ room_id ])`. Turning it off keeps all existing memberships.
- `Rooms::OpensController` and `rooms/opens/_user.html.erb` render checkmarks for people and auto-joining bots, and toggle switches (`user_ids[]`) for bots with `add_to_all_open_rooms: false` so admins/room creators can manually add or remove those bots in individual open rooms.

## HTTP API (Async Posting)
- `POST /rooms/:room_id/:bot_code/messages` handled by `Rooms::BotMessagesController#create`.
- Skips session authentication and CSRF forgery protection; authenticates via `User.authenticate_bot(params[:bot_code])` (`active.bot.find_by(bot_token: ...)`).
- Reads `request.raw_post` (forced to UTF-8) directly as the message body so shell scripts/CI jobs can use `curl -d "..."` without JSON envelopes or form-decoding corruption. Supports `multipart/form-data` with `attachment` file uploads via `create_with_attachment!`.
- Broadcasts the message (`@message.broadcast_create`) and triggers `Room::PushMessageJob` via `Message`'s `after_create_commit` callback.

## Outgoing Webhooks (Mentions, Joined & Sync Replies)
- **Mention events**: When a message is committed (`Message` `after_create_commit -> { room.receive(self) }`), `Room#deliver_webhooks_later` enqueues one `Bot::WebhookJob` per mentioned active bot in the room that has a `webhook_url` (excluding the message creator to avoid self-loops).
- **Joined events**: Whenever a bot is newly added to a non-direct room (`Rooms::Open` or `Rooms::Closed`), either automatically (`add_to_all_open_rooms`) or manually (`grant_to` / `Membership.create!`), `Bot::WebhookJob` is enqueued with `(bot, room)` once per newly created membership (after transaction commit). Bulk `Membership.insert_all(..., returning: ...)` guarantees existing memberships do not trigger duplicate `joined` events. `Rooms::Direct` never triggers `joined`.
- `Bot::Webhook` posts `Content-Type: application/json` to `bot.webhook_url` asynchronously in `Bot::WebhookJob`:
  - `mention` payload includes `event`, `author`, `room`, and `message` (stripping only the target bot's mention node from `message.body.text`).
  - `joined` payload includes `event: "joined"` and `room: { id, name, reply_to }`.
- For both events, a `200` response with `Content-Type: text/plain` or `text/html` (and non-blank body) posts a reply message into the room as the bot and calls `broadcast_create`. `204` (or non-200/unsupported content type) posts nothing.
